'''''Cunninghamia konishii''''', also known as '''Taiwanese China fir''',<ref name=Kirkham/> is an [[endangered]] species of tree in the cypress family, [[Cupressaceae]]. It is native to southeast China ([[Fujian]]), Taiwan, Laos and Vietnam.<ref name=POWO_676724-1/>

==Taxonomy==
Although ''C. konishii'' is treated as a distinct species by many sources, it has also been suggested that it is conspecific with ''[[Cunninghamia lanceolata|C. lanceolata]]''.<ref name=LuChiaHongHu99/><ref name=ChunLinTanLin04/>
